summary: Validated narrow-scope change on /booking Step 1 (Choose a package). Each package card now renders a data-testid=pkg-{key}-includes <ul> with the correct number of <li> children (Standard=6, Deluxe=4, Fresh Start=7) and strings match /app/frontend/src/config/pricing.js verbatim. Package selection updates gold-champagne border and the Live Summary total ($189 Standard / $249 Deluxe / $329 Fresh Start for default Two Bedroom). btn-next advances to step-details. No regressions observed in the touched step.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking.jsx uses a decorative '·' character inside a <span> as a bullet. Not a bug, but tests that read li textContent will pick up the bullet — consider using CSS ::marker or list-disc to keep DOM text clean.
PACKAGES[].includes strings are hardcoded in both /app/frontend/src/config/pricing.js and mirrored in /app/backend/pricing.py per header comment — reminder to keep both in sync if strings change.
